name: Gyakuten Shihai ~Kairai no Onna Kyoushi~
original_name: 逆転支配 ～傀儡の女教師～
source:
Private Meiryo Academy is a prestigious college-preparatory school that has produced countless brilliant minds. Because of its record, many students apply for admission every year, but the academy is entrenched in an elitist ideology: rather than being a school chosen by students, it is a school that chooses its students.

From teachers whose parents are influential figures in the board of education to others, none of the teachers question the idea of dominating the students, and they act with impunity, using their privileged status as a license for arrogance.

Then, a certain male student transfers into the academy. He has a predilection for deriving sexual excitement from humbling conceited, prideful women, and he also possesses the ability to alter the perceptions of others.

Using this special power as a weapon, the male student begins his activities to trample upon the female teachers who sit complacently in their privileged positions. The academy's long-standing system of control is about to be brought to an end by the desires of a single student...

[Translated from [url=https://www.bugbug.news/b_game/276614/]BugBug[/url]]
